State machine parser for slot delta entries, groups, and transaction results.

# Purpose
`fd_slot_delta_parser.c` implements a state machine parser for slot delta data. It reads a byte stream and decodes a sequence of slot delta entries, each entry containing a slot number, a root flag, status data, blockhash values, transaction index data, and transaction result data. The parser stores decoded values in an internal `fd_sstxncache_entry_t` record and uses `entry_avail` and `group_avail` flags to report parsed entries and parsed groups to the caller through [`fd_slot_delta_parser_consume`](<#fd_slot_delta_parser_consume>).

The file also manages parser memory and parser state. It defines the parser layout, alignment, footprint, creation, join, leave, delete, and init functions. It uses a slot pool and a slot set to track parsed slots and reject duplicate slot entries. Validation code checks limits such as maximum entry count, duplicate slots, and root status, and the state logic maps transaction error discriminants into stored result codes.
